title: Anthropic expands partnership with Google and Broadcom for multiple gigawatts of next-generation compute
raw_excerpt: Anthropic has signed an agreement with Google and Broadcom for multiple gigawatts of next-generation TPU capacity expected to come online starting in 2027. The capacity is necessary to serve the exponential growth in Anthropic's customer base. It will also enable Claude to define the frontier of AI development. The vast majority of the new compute will be sited in the US.
summary: Anthropic宣布与Google和Broadcom达成协议，获取多个吉瓦级下一代TPU计算能力，预计2027年起上线。这笔巨额计算资源将用于满足客户指数级增长需求，并推动Claude模型在AI前沿领域的发展。新计算设施大部分将部署在美国境内，体现了Anthropic对算力基础设施的战略投入。

title: GrandCode: Achieving Grandmaster Level in Competitive Programming via Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: GrandCode提出了一种基于强化学习的智能体框架，在编程竞赛中达到大师级水平。该研究通过智能体强化学习，让AI在复杂编程任务中自主探索和优化策略，显著提升了代码生成与调试能力。这一成果展示了RL在算法竞赛领域的巨大潜力，为AI编程能力提升提供了新路径。

title: Anthropic buys biotech startup Coefficient Bio in $400M deal
raw_excerpt: Anthropic acquired biotech AI startup Coefficient Bio for $400 million in stock to bolster its healthcare and life sciences ventures. Coefficient Bio, founded by former Genentech researchers, used AI to expedite drug discovery and biological research. The 10-person team will integrate into Anthropic's health and life sciences division.
summary: Anthropic以4亿美元股票收购生物科技AI初创公司Coefficient Bio，该公司由前基因泰克研究员创立，专注于利用AI加速药物发现和生物学研究。10人团队将并入Anthropic健康与生命科学部门。此举标志着AI巨头向垂直行业深度渗透，生物医药成为AI应用的重要战场。

title: Issue: Claude Code is unusable for complex engineering tasks with Feb updates
summary: GitHub上大量开发者反馈，Claude Code在2026年2月更新后无法胜任复杂工程任务。问题涉及代码生成质量下降、上下文理解错误等，引发754条评论。该事件暴露了AI编程工具在快速迭代中可能出现的性能倒退问题，对依赖AI辅助开发的团队影响重大。

title: Adam's Law: Textual Frequency Law on Large Language Models
summary: Adam's Law论文揭示了大型语言模型中的文本频率定律：模型对高频词汇的预测准确率显著高于低频词汇，且这种偏差随模型规模增大而加剧。该研究为理解LLM的行为偏差提供了理论基础，对模型评估、数据配比和公平性研究具有重要指导意义。

title: Interaction-Aware Video Object Removal (GitHub Repo)
raw_excerpt: Netflix's VOID is a video inpainting model that removes objects along with their physical and visual interactions, using interaction-aware mask conditioning built on CogVideoX.
summary: Netflix开源了VOID模型，一种基于CogVideoX的视频修复工具，能够智能移除视频中的物体及其物理和视觉交互痕迹。该模型通过交互感知掩码条件，在保持背景连贯性的同时处理复杂动态场景，为影视后期和内容创作提供了强大的AI工具。

title: GitNexus (GitHub Repo)
raw_excerpt: GitNexus indexes entire codebases into knowledge graphs, making AI agents like Cursor and Claude Code aware of every relationship, from dependencies to call chains. It offers a CLI for deep integration with editors and a web UI for visual exploration, both providing comprehensive context and reducing the likelihood of blind edits and breaking changes.
summary: GitNexus是一个开源工具，能将整个代码库索引为知识图谱，让Cursor、Claude Code等AI代理感知代码间的依赖、调用链等关系。它提供CLI和Web UI，帮助AI在大型项目中减少盲目编辑和破坏性变更，显著提升代码理解和修改的准确性。

title: Show HN: Ghost Pepper – Local hold-to-talk speech-to-text for macOS
raw_excerpt: I built this because I wanted to see how far I could get with a voice-to-text app that used 100% local models so no data left my computer. I've been using a ton for coding and emails. Experimenting with using it as a voice interface for my other agents too. 100% open-source MIT license, would love feedback, PRs, and ideas on where to take it.
summary: Ghost Pepper是一款macOS本地语音转文字应用，采用100%本地模型，无需联网，确保数据隐私。支持按住说话、实时转录，适用于编程、邮件等场景。完全开源（MIT许可），展示了端侧AI语音识别的实用性和隐私优势。

title: OpenAI tests next-gen Image V2 model on ChatGPT and LM Arena
raw_excerpt: OpenAI is testing its next-gen Image V2 model on ChatGPT and LM Arena in three variants. Early tests show improvements in UI design rendering, prompt adherence, and compositional understanding. The outcome of these tests could bolster OpenAI's competitive position against Google's offerings.
summary: OpenAI正在ChatGPT和LM Arena上测试下一代Image V2模型，包含三个变体。早期测试显示，新模型在UI设计渲染、提示遵循和构图理解方面有显著改进。此举旨在巩固OpenAI在图像生成领域的竞争力，应对Google等对手的挑战。

title: Offline AI Dictation App from Google
raw_excerpt: Google released an iOS app using on-device ASR models for dictation that offers live transcription, filler-word removal, and optional cloud-based editing via Gemini models.
summary: Google悄然发布了一款iOS离线AI听写应用，使用设备端ASR模型实现实时转录、填充词移除等功能，并可选通过Gemini模型进行云端编辑。该应用强调隐私和离线可用性，为移动端语音输入提供了新的选择。
